title: Chapter 100 — The AI Roleplay Training System
intro: Scenario design, drill rotations, feedback loops, deliberate practice.

sections.title: Why Roleplay Works
sections.content:
You cannot improve your closing technique by reading about closing. You improve by practicing closing — repeatedly, in realistic scenarios, with feedback.

AI roleplay gives you unlimited practice partners. The AI can be the budget-conscious customer, the researcher with a phone full of prices, the couple in conflict, the contractor who needs a quote in 10 minutes, or the luxury buyer who wants to be guided, not sold.

Every scenario you practice is one less scenario that catches you off guard on the floor.

sections.title: How to Practice
sections.content:
Pick one skill per session. Do not practice everything at once. Today: practice the greeting with five different customer types. Tomorrow: practice handling 'I can get it cheaper online' from three different angles. Next day: practice the package close.

Ask the AI for feedback after each scenario. What did you do well? Where did you lose momentum? What would the customer have felt at each transition?

Repetition builds muscle memory. After practicing the price objection response 20 times with AI, the 21st time — on the floor with a real customer — feels natural instead of forced.

sections.title: KPI-Scored Scenarios
sections.content:
The AI roleplay system in IQ Academy scores your performance on specific KPIs: did you build rapport before discovery? Did you use FAB in your demo? Did you address the objection before closing? Did you ask for the sale?

These scores tell you exactly which skills need more practice. A rep who scores 90 percent on discovery but 40 percent on closing knows exactly where to focus their next 10 practice sessions.
